operational_always_on: collision/readiness checks and required data viewer
edit transaction/revision integrity and fixed-work proxy autosaves
complete synchronous terrain enforcement clocks and whole-frame carry
geometric priority admission and one bounded directional preparation viewer
shipping_optional: callback interval count, sum, maximum and deadline-miss counters
one native/resource snapshot per completed simulation second; at most 72 telemetry rows
bounded shipping summary allocation, serialization, write, flush, close and retained telemetry disposal per trial
forensic_additions: native per-operation frame trace, batching, CSV writer and drain for all three phases
per-callback asynchronous renderer CPU/GPU queries and detailed JSONL write/flush
common_external_qualification_observers: monotonic whole-trial, lifecycle, matching-route-section, callback and positive-dose clocks
fixed-work interval histogram and callback accounting including the last callback
per-callback native/resource snapshots, caps, frontier scan/evaluation and bounded qualification CSV
native lifetime/phase aggregates and operation-limit checks at closure (not raw operation tracing)
accepted-edit-to-mesh-submission observer, event serialization, bounded writer and final acknowledgement
per-physics collision elapsed timers, actual pose, command fingerprint, work counts, preparation handover and dose evidence CSV
per-trial correctness report construction, serialization, hashing of trace files, flush and close
outside_complete_trial_common_harness: process launch, project import, common scene/UI initialization and one complete warm-up trial
terminal timing marker write (separately clocked, never folded into optional cost)
bounded between-trial report retention/deep-copy and finite protocol selection; at most 13 trial records
batch summary/identity hashing, independent-reader work, return-to-title UI and process exit
disabled_in_all_pilot_modes: legacy calibration/flatness classifiers as qualification decisions
estimand: Incremental complete-trial elapsed effect of shipping_optional, conditional on the common operational work and external qualification observers. Not total diagnostic CPU/GPU overhead or a physical-presentation measurement.
boundary: One start/end subtraction: before optional setup and fixture preparation through 4320 fixed physics ticks, final edit acknowledgement, native phase closure, writer drain, terrain/preparation retirement, optional summary serialization/flush/close and complete per-trial report serialization/flush/close. Nested spans are evidence, not additive costs.

protocol.shipping_condition: null and positive controls both pass; otherwise stop without another calibration family
protocol.positive_dose: Synchronous native SHA256 work after each of 4320 real fixed physics ticks. Per-tick request ceil(0.02 * complete positive A0 duration / 4320) microseconds, fixed before B1. Record each actual span/update count/digest. No sleep, yield, I/O, terminal substitute or time-per-callback normalization. Idle absorption is a failed sensitivity control, not a passing zero.
protocol.stop_rule: On overlap, negative attribution, unresolved matching-section drift, invalid controls or missing work/I/O/operation evidence: inconclusive; stop and request an explicit measurement/repetition/threshold policy decision. No automatic reruns or profile matrix.
